scoring_rules.description: Each item scored 0-100. Recency (0-40): today=40, yesterday=32, 2d=24, 3d=16, 7d=8, 14d=4. AML keywords (0-25): matched terms from 30-word AML lexicon, capped at 25. Source trust (0-10): official regulator RSS=10, scrape=7, news=4.
